tagline: Leo always wins. Adults never learn.
premise: Leo is 8. Adults give him a rule. Leo follows the rule EXACTLY as said, and the adults lose. Every episode ends with the scoreboard: KID LOGIC vs ADULTS.

leo.personality: the hero; calm, polite, takes every rule literally, always one step ahead
leo.habits: smug shrug when he wins; says 'Easy.'

mia.personality: Leo's big sister; dramatic, always on her phone, sometimes Leo's partner in crime

mom.personality: strict but loving; makes the rules; shouts 'LEO!' when she loses

dad.personality: lazy and funny; tries to be the cool dad; has small secrets (donuts, naps, video games)

grandpa.personality: loves 'back in my day' stories; confused by phones; secretly on Leo's side

ms_lee.personality: Leo's teacher; strict, tired, but she laughs when Leo is clever

zoe.personality: Leo's best friend; asks the questions the viewer is thinking

formula: COLD OPEN (2 lines): the funniest disaster from the end of the story. An adult shouts a short question with one *KEY* word. Freeze, then rewind.
SETUP (1-2 lines): an adult gives Leo a simple RULE. The viewer must hear the rule clearly.
THREE BEATS: Leo follows the rule literally, 3 times, each one bigger. The adult reacts each time.
TWIST: the rule comes back to the adult. The adult loses. The punchline is the shortest line (max 6 words).
SIGN-OFF: Leo says 'Kid logic. Easy.' and the scoreboard appears (added automatically).
